about: HVACQTO (CLAUDE.md, HVACQTO classification): the drawing is not changed. The workbook (dumped as qto.<cad>.xml): equipment named by the FCU-CAS-n kW wording, duct area per sheet band from 2*(W+H)*L (400x300: 1.5 m -> 2.1 m2 in the 0.58 mm band; 600x300: 2+3 = 5 m -> 9 m2 in the 0.75 mm band), copper by the RP layer pair (12.7-6.4: 5 m of D6.4 and 5 m of D12.7), uPVC by the condensate layer (D27, 4 m), steel by the CHWS layer (DN100, 10 m). The bands and the exact row wording are what the HVACQTO core tests pin down; the quantities are derived from the drawn lengths.
